reviewer: Separate read-only agent, previously responsible for the MuPDF contribution; not the Moon backlog author.
scope: All 64 proposals and their navigation catalog, compared with the retained official baseline, supplied-artifact findings, Android and desktop/web dossiers, and their source ledgers.
conclusions: Distinctness was assessed by requested user outcome, not string uniqueness alone.
MOON-002 reflects the helper's non-throwing failure paths while preserving the application-reproduction gap.
MOON-004 is cover-sync-specific and retains the unresolved shared-worker limitation.
Existing reflow, settings search, Readwise, forms, speech, export, synchronization and relinking capabilities are acknowledged.
Every proposal remains a draft; numerical budgets and acceptance scenarios are prospective.
limitations: This is an agent evidence review, not human or developer approval.
External sources were compared with retained research, not fetched again during review.
The review did not execute application workflows or acceptance scenarios, authenticate the supplied APK, verify native or decompiler correctness, or exhaust upstream duplicate reports.
Changes to the reviewed inputs require reassessment of affected conclusions.
